items.title: Australia's fuel crisis deepens: waste collection under threat, diesel hits $4.25/L
items.summary: Waste collectors warn bin services could stop within days as diesel becomes nearly impossible to source, while prices hit $4.25/L in remote areas.
items.detail: The fuel crisis triggered by the US-Israel war on Iran is now hitting essential services hard. Waste collectors say they're operating at unsustainable losses, freight costs are up 40%, and some Tasmanian service stations have run out of unleaded entirely.
